services.name: SUP Yoga
services.desc: Stand Up Paddleboarding (SUP) is the fastest growing water sport in the world. It’s a great way to get on the water and have fun while increasing balance, coordination, core stability, strength, and endurance. Plus, it’s an outdoor activity the whole family will enjoy! Take your favorite fitness and wellness practices to the board in a nurturing, outdoor studio. Soak up the therapeutic benefits of being surrounded by water, using your paddleboard as a fun balance trainer improving core strength and stabilization. We offer “stand up,” certified instruction, bringing our background of core stabilization, postural alignment, energy direction and breathwork into our quality paddling lessons. We

explain.meaning: A stand-up paddleboard: a large board you stand on and paddle.

blurb: Wave of Wellness guides small group tours through waters in Thailand, Mexico, Florida, and beyond, combining adventurous activities with relaxation on bucket list beaches. They offer paddleboard tours in Florida and fitness classes including yoga for private groups and events. Featured tours include the Winter Park Venetian Canal SUP Tour, a Punta de Mita adventure with multiple activities, and a unique Florida houseboat adventure.
